purpose: Declares the candidate BEFORE the protected holdout is run. Its presence makes CI run the holdout; the holdout is run once for this candidate and its results are reported as measured. The interpreter is not changed in response to holdout results; any later change needs a new, freshly frozen holdout.

selectionEvidence.reproducibility: CI runs 44324072176 and 44324679557 produced identical results for the unchanged v2 interpreter

holdout.knownExposure: Same author as the operator; two holdout phrasings were typed into a unit check during v2 development (no code changed in response).
